name: postbuzz
description: Run social media from your agent: compose, schedule, queue, inbox, and analytics across 16+ platforms via the post.buzz MCP server.

api_key.title: post.buzz API key
api_key.description: Create one at post.buzz → Settings → API Keys. Starts with sx_live_. Required for every post.buzz tool.

api_url.title: API base URL
api_url.description: Override only for staging or self-hosting. Default: https://post.buzz/api
